newsitem.title: USA: Bethlehem Steel continues shipyard talks.
newsitem.headline: Bethlehem Steel continues shipyard talks.

text.p: Bethlehem Steel Corp said Tuesday the workforce at the BethShip Sparrows Point Yard near Baltimore has been cut to 115 as negotiations on the yard's future continue.
At one time, the company noted, it had set a June 30 deadline for sale of the yard.

"At the present time, Bethlehem Steel is continuing to have discussions with Baltimore Shipbuilding and Drydock LLC in an effort to resolve certain complex issues relating to the sale of Bethlehem's BethShip Sparrows Point Yard in Maryland," the company's statement said.

"Currently there is no work in the Yard and management has reduced the overall workforce to about 115 employees to maintain facilities and to preserve, for now, the ability for a new owner to resume operations promptly in the event of a sale."
